parsed.post: Discarding last experiment. The decrease in learning rate and introduction of weight decay actually increased val_bpb from 0.8588 to 0.8806. It seems the model was already near a local optimum or the LR/WD combination was too aggressive for the 5-minute budget. Reverting to acaa3f2.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best (acaa3f2) after the last hyperparameter change failed to improve performance.
